integrity: An analytic global-uniqueness proof using the Gaussian orthant covariance and a strictly monotone scalar equation, with supplied separate reproducibility checks. No external/independent mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed one-shot deterministic noiseless observation of standard zero-start Brownian motion on [0,1] and its positive occupation fraction. The result does not cover noisy, adaptive, sign-only, weighted or multiple measurements, and does not establish publication priority. Numerical decimals follow from an exact monotone equation.
title: A unique best single snapshot for Brownian positive occupation time
